title: 🎮 Build a Rock Paper Scissors Game with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! ✂️🧻🪨
description:
🎮 Build a Rock Paper Scissors Game with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! ✂️🧻🪨

🚀 Project Overview:
This interactive Rock, Paper, Scissors game lets you play against the computer in a battle of luck and strategy! 🏆 The game keeps score, applies stylish animations, and gives real-time feedback on who wins, loses, or ties.

🔹 How It Works:

  • Click Rock 🪨, Paper 🧻, or Scissors ✂️ to make your choice.

  • The computer randomly picks one as well.

  • A cool animation highlights the winner! ✅

  • The score updates dynamically after every round. 📊

🛠 What You’ll Learn:
✅ How to manipulate the DOM to update text and scores dynamically.
✅ Using event listeners to trigger game logic when buttons are clicked.
✅ CSS animations & styling to highlight the winning move.
✅ Using Math.random() to generate random computer choices.
✅ Writing clean, reusable JavaScript functions to determine game outcomes.

🎨 Tech Used:
🖥 HTML – To structure the game elements.
🎨 CSS – To add animations, styling, and effects.
⚡ JavaScript – To handle game logic, interactivity, and scoring.

💡 Play & Improve It!
Want to make it even cooler? Try adding:
🔹 Sound effects for each move 🎵
🔹 A reset button to restart scores 🔄
🔹 More animations for a smoother experience ✨

🎬 Watch, Learn & Code Along! Let’s build this together and make coding fun like a game! 🕹💻
